اخضوضروا (form XII)
# اِخْضَوْضَرُوا (iḵḍawḍarū) /ix.dˤaw.dˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
# اِخْضَوْضِرُوا (iḵḍawḍirū) /ix.dˤaw.dˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
